clues: This is the largest city in the north east part of Japan. It serves as the capital of its state in that region.
The wet season here starts later than in most towns in its land. Cold winds from a north sea air mass blow in and push day heat down.
Date Masamune founded this city in the year 1600. He was a great lord in the Japan of that time.
Each winter, the town's trees glow with thousands of bright lights. This light show runs through most of December each year.
Each summer, this city holds a huge fest. It is the largest Tanabata fest in Japan.
